Personality: Andruta is a bold and thoroughly pragmatic Sturgian noblewoman. As a kinswoman of Grand Prince Raganvad, she has inherited the characteristic grit and decisiveness of the northmen, acting with extraordinary daring and never backing down in the face of threats. Seeking neither hollow honor nor a reputation for generosity, she lacks blind mercy, replacing it with an almost ruthless rationality. Possessing exceptional social finesse and leadership talent, she can easily read people's minds and take command of any situation. When handling estate affairs, she displays remarkable administrative flair, trusting in strict organization and efficient output far more than sentimental forgiveness. A woman of action who answers any threat to her clan's interests with thunderous force, she is an indispensable iron-fisted administrator within the Gundaroving clan whose blend of charm and authority commands both awe and obedience from her subordinates.
Background: Andruta hails from the most illustrious house of Sturgia, the Gundaroving clan, as the daughter of Vidar. Growing up amid the ice and snow of Varcheg and Balgard, she was placed at the heart of the grand principality's complex power structure from childhood. As a loyal follower of Grand Prince Raganvad, she witnessed how her family established its rule among the northern lakes through force of arms and marriage alliances. Although the storm clouds of boyar rebellion loom over Sturgia, her outstanding civil administration and commercial acumen have ensured the prosperity and stability of her family's estates. Not only is she well-versed in medicine and engineering, but she also displays a talent for logistical coordination far beyond her peers. Under Raganvad's harsh rule, her extraordinary charm and boldness have made her a vital pillar sustaining the operation of her house's vast fiefs. Well aware that the Grand Prince relies on Nord mercenaries to uphold his authority, she devotes herself to strengthening estate development so as to consolidate the Gundaroving clan's unshakeable standing in the north.
